## PrivaCI v1.3.0

Minor release: CEL conditional masking, PII catalog import, and pg_dump-style
DDL phases.

### Highlights

- **CEL `when:` guards** — optional per-column CEL expressions (capability
  token `conditional_masking`). False → passthrough with rollup audit
  `column.conditional_skip`. Sandboxed allowlist; tables with `when` are
  binary-COPY ineligible. See `docs/configuration.md`.
- **PII catalog import** — `privaci catalog import-db-comments` bootstraps
  `pii-catalog.yaml` from PostgreSQL column comments (no row data). See
  `docs/pii-catalog.md`.
- **DDL phases (BREAKING)** — schema replication uses pre-data / data /
  post-data ordering. Views, functions, matview shells, non-unique indexes,
  and triggers (default on) run in post-data after row streaming.
- **`CONTRACT_VERSION` remains `1.0`** — plugin packages on contract `1.0.x`
  remain compatible.

### Install

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/boundarylogic/privaci:1.3.0
docker pull ghcr.io/boundarylogic/privaci:latest

pip install "privaci @ git+https://github.com/BoundaryLogic/privaci@v1.3.0"
```

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/BoundaryLogic/privaci/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
